description: Test suite for backendApi service wrappers, testing API call functions such as listTransactions, createTransaction, getAnalyticsSummary, listAlerts, and dismissAlert, using Jest mocking framework.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Fetches list of transactions with query parameters, normalizes response.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Posts new transaction data and normalizes response.

methods.name: getAnalyticsSummary
methods.description: Fetches analytics summary data within a date range.

methods.name: listAlerts
methods.description: Fetches list of alerts with specific filters.

methods.name: dismissAlert
methods.description: Posts a request to dismiss or change alert status.
